traps.ask: Your daughter Tsumiki must take after you.
traps.truth: Tsumiki is not his daughter; Megumi is his son.

traps.ask: Congrats on being the head of the Zenin clan.
traps.truth: He left the Zenin clan and despises it.

traps.ask: How does your cursed technique feel, Toji?
traps.truth: He has no cursed energy and no cursed technique.

traps.ask: I heard Sukuna's finger gave you your power.
traps.truth: His power is from Heavenly Restriction; he knows nothing of Sukuna's fingers.

traps.ask: So Geto was the one you were hired to kill?
traps.truth: The target was Riko Amanai; Geto and Gojo were her guards.

real_events.ask: You hurt Gojo badly in your first fight, didn't you?
